name: Agag
overview: Agag was a king of the Amalekites, noted in Scripture for his capture by Saul during God's command to utterly destroy the Amalekites. While Saul took Agag alive after defeating the Amalekites, Samuel later executed him, pronouncing judgment in Gilgal as a direct consequence of Saul's incomplete obedience. The mention of Agag in Numbers highlights the prominence of his kingship, which was ultimately humbled through God's sovereign judgment.
